Each rule declares glob patterns; when the agent reads or edits a matching file, the rule act"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ivates and its content (any prompt or markdown document) is injected into the co"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-rules"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Glob-activated rule prompts for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — a Claude Code `rules.md` / `# Path:`-style "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"mechanism. Each rule declares glob patterns; when the agent **reads or edits** a matching file, the "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"rule activates and its content (any prompt or markdown document) is injected into the conversation a"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"s a superseding `<rules>` snapshot."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Works in **every DSH deployment**: desktop / web / tui / headless / custom profiles — nothing abou"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"t this plugin is desktop-specific."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Contents"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Features
- How it works
- Installation
- Rule format
- Configuration
- Discoverability
- Limitatio"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ns
- Development
- License"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Glob activation** — rules activate per file the agent touches: `**`, `*`, `?`, `{a,b}`, `[abc]`,"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" and `!` negation (picomatch).
- **Claude Code compatible** — plain rule files (`.dsh/rules/*.md`) *"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"and* `# Path:` sections inside `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md`.
- **Visible & durable** — active rules are"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" injected as a user message the UI shows and the session log persists; each injection appears in the"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" chat as a collapsible row (same chrome as tool-call rows) with a one-line notice — e.g. `dsh-rules "},{"id":"p9s6","text":"· Active rules: typescript, docs` — expanding to the full rules text. Each snapshot supersedes earli"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"er ones, so the model always sees the current set.
- **Budget-bounded** — byte-budget rendering (32 "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"KB default): low-priority rules are dropped first, then the last rule is truncated; content is escap"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"ed so it can never break out of the framing tags.
- **Resume-friendly** — on session resume the last"},{"id":"p9s10","text":" snapshot and its matched files are restored from the log, preventing duplicate injection.
- **Per-s"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"ession tracking** — every agent/session tracks its own touched files (subagents included); global ru"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"les (no `path:`) are always active."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Injection point**: an `agent/pre-step` waterfall listener appends a `<rules>`-framed user messag"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"e; a new message is only appended when the active rule set or a rule's content changes. The matched-"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"file list inside a snapshot is informational — a step that only adds matched files never re-sends th"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"e rule bodies.
- **Discovery & caching**: rule sources are re-probed per step with version caching ("},{"id":"p12s5","text":"`fs.stat().version`, or `mtimeMs:size` on the Node fallback) — edits to rule files take effect on th"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"e next step.
- **Reads**: prefer the harness `fs` service (containment-aware); fall back to Node's f"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ilesystem when no `fs` service is mounted."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Any DSH deployment (generic)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Published on the npm registry — `dsh plugin` installs **and activates** the plugin in one step:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the reconcile pass of `dsh plugin add` appends `dsh-rule"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"s` to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer list automatically — **no manual `cordis.patch.yml` "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"edits are needed**. Restart DSH (restart the desktop app; restart the web/headless process) and the "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"plugin loads with the next Cordis composition."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Updates: `dsh plugin --profile desktop update dsh-rules` (or remove + add)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Installing from a local checkout (development):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> ⚠️ pnpm splits `add` arguments on spaces, so a repository **path containing spaces** must be insta"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"lled through a no-space junction (see below)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### DSH Desktop (Windows) one-click script"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The script creates a no-space junction to the repo and runs the desktop app's own `dsh plugin add` t"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"hrough it (pnpm splits `add` arguments on spaces, so a repository path containing spaces must go thr"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"its `add` arguments on spaces, so a repository path containing spaces must go through the junction):"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Per-profile configuration (optional): the plugin loads with its code defaults; to customize, overrid"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"e the entry's `config` in `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"**Uninstall**: `node scripts\install-desktop.mjs --uninstall` (or `dsh plugin --profile desktop remo"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ve dsh-rules`), then restart the app. Installing/uninstalling never touches the DSH installation dir"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ectory (`resources\app.asar.unpacked`) — only profile configuration, fully reversible."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Rule format"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Source A: rule files (`.dsh/rules/*.md` and `~/.dsh/rules/*.md`)"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Frontmatter field | Description |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| `path` | String or list of globs, relative to the project root, `/` separators; `!` prefixes mark "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"exclusion patterns. **Absent or empty = always-active global rule** (active for any session in the w"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"orkspace). |
| `name` | Optional; rule identity (used for same-name deduplication). Defaults to the "},{"id":"p33s4","text":"file name without `.md`. |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"### Source B: `# Path:` sections (requires `includeClaudeSections: true`)"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Parses `# Path: <globs…>` headings out of `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` (including `.local.md` variants "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"and `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`):"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- Each `# Path:` heading starts a rule that runs until the next heading (or end of file).
- Globs ma"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"y be comma- or space-separated.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- Only files **inside the project root** can activate rules; reads outside the root never trigger (a"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"voids `../` false positives).
- The touched-path set is in-memory: after resuming a session, rules r"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"e-activate as the agent re-reads files (the previously matched list is restored from the log).
- Dep"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"loyments with `includeRuntimeContext: false` are unaffected — this plugin injects its own message an"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"d does not depend on the runtime-context snapshot.
- Rules are injected as "superseding snapshot" me"},{"id":"p39s6","text":"ssages; the session log retains historical snapshots, but each snapshot is the complete current set "},{"id":"p39s7","text":"and the model follows the latest one.
- A snapshot's `matched files` list is a record of the moment "},{"id":"p39s8","text":"it was rendered: files matched later do not re-send the rules, so that list can lag behind the sessi"},{"id":"p39s9","text":"on. The active set is always the one in the latest snapshot."}],"truncated":true}
